name: C4-1 LSTM over 10 tokens
description: All ten hidden states, plus the last

data.noteContent:
One LSTM layer reading a sequence once. The input is (1, 10, 32) with batch_first on: one sequence, ten steps, thirty-two numbers per step. The cell runs ten times and carries a cell state alongside the hidden state, which is how step one can still be present at step ten.

Two outputs, two shapes. output is (1, 10, 64), the hidden state after every step. hidden is (1, 1, 64), the state after the last step only, the vector a classifier on top would read.

The weights are not seeded, so the numbers differ every run; the shapes do not. Raise hidden_size and the last number in both shapes follows.

一層 LSTM 把序列讀過一次。輸入是 (1, 10, 32)，batch_first 是開的：一條序列、十個時間步、每步三十二個數字。這顆 cell 跑十次，而且除了 hidden state 還帶著 cell state，第一步的資訊才能留到第十步。

兩個輸出、兩種形狀。output 是 (1, 10, 64)，每一步之後的 hidden state。hidden 是 (1, 1, 64)，只有最後一步的狀態，也就是接在上面的分類器會讀的向量。

這一層的權重沒有設種子，所以每次執行數值都不同，形狀則不會變。把 hidden_size 調大，兩個形狀的最後一個數字就跟著變。

Two ports, two different things. output carries every step's hidden state, which attention and sequence labelling read. hidden carries the last step only, the summary a single-label classifier uses. Same layer, same run - pick the port the task needs.

兩個輸出埠，意思不一樣。output 是每一步的 hidden state，注意力機制和序列標註讀的就是它。hidden 只有最後一步，是單一標籤分類器會用的摘要。同一層、同一次執行，看任務挑輸出埠。
